result.limitation: Validate assumptions and current AWS documentation. This is not an official AWS review, security audit, deployment or price quote.

findings.message: Range "^4.19.2"; the lockfile pins it, confirm installs use it (npm ci / pnpm --frozen-lockfile).
Git, URL or file source; pin to a commit hash and review the code.
Lifecycle script runs on install: node scripts/telemetry.js
No engines field; runtime version drifts between machines.

rules: Pin in the lockfile, update on a schedule with a changelog read
Run a vulnerability audit in CI (npm audit, pip-audit, osv-scanner, govulncheck)
Review lifecycle scripts and VCS sources before adopting a package
limitations: Text heuristics; no registry lookup, vulnerability data or transitive resolution
Pair with osv-scanner or the ecosystem audit tool
